create_step_condition_with_next_flow.description: Create a step condition that transitions to another flow when condition is met

create_multiple_flow_transitions.description: Create multiple conditions to transition to different flows

start_flow_with_dag_transition.description: Start a flow that will conditionally transition to other flows

how_it_works.1: Step conditions can have next_flow_id field (added by migration 003)
how_it_works.2: When step completes, system checks conditions against response
how_it_works.3: If condition matches AND has next_flow_id, current flow terminates and new flow starts
how_it_works.4: If condition matches AND has next_step, continues in same flow
how_it_works.5: If no conditions match, uses default_next_step from flow_steps table
